supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 made repeated connections to the explicit proxy at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:40 through 14:10 UTC. The connection records identify the proxy, not the tunneled destinations.

At 14:10, the proxy logged a successful CONNECT tunnel to update.chartmate-imaging.net, and endpoint telemetry attributed the proxy connection to cmupdate.exe running from Ben Carter's AppData path. The inventory instead specifies update.chartmate-imaging.com and a cmupdate.exe path under Program Files; this discrepancy is suspicious but does not by itself prove the updater is malicious.

A successful network logon for omar.haddad was recorded on WS-OHADDAD-01 with WS-BCARTER-01 as the originating workstation. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-OHADDAD-01, making this use of the administrator account from WS-BCARTER-01 inconsistent with stated practice.
Earlier in the review window, maria.lopez credentials were validated from WS-BCARTER-01 and a successful network logon for maria.lopez was recorded on WS-MLOPEZ-01.

Dropbox.exe was launched from Ben Carter's interactive session. Dropbox is a file-sharing service, and the inventory states that no file-sharing service other than the listed approved services is approved.
A file named installer-70930.exe was created in Ben Carter's Downloads folder during the review window; these records do not show that it was executed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage status reports a collection outage for WS-BCARTER-01 winsec and sysmon telemetry from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, and for proxy telemetry during the same interval. This overlaps the alert period and prevents attribution of most connections in that interval to processes or destinations.
Zeek connection records during the interval show connections to the proxy but do not identify the tunneled HTTPS destinations.
The available proxy record identifies the destination at 14:10, but does not establish the destination or contents of earlier tunnels.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections before 14:10 were all made by cmupdate.exe or were to the ChartMate service.
Whether the AppData cmupdate.exe and the .net destination are an authorized ChartMate variant or an impersonation.
Whether Dropbox transferred files, or whether any data was exfiltrated.
Whether installer-70930.exe was executed or is malicious.
Whether the administrator-account logon was used to perform administrative actions, or how the credentials were obtained.
additional_evidence_needed: Restore or retrieve WS-BCARTER-01 winsec and sysmon telemetry for 13:30–14:10, including process creation, network connections, file activity, and authentication events.
Retrieve proxy CONNECT logs, DNS records, and TLS metadata for WS-BCARTER-01 throughout the alert interval to identify destinations and connection patterns.
Verify the ChartMate updater's hash, signature, installation source, expected path, and approved update domains with the software owner or vendor.
Inspect Dropbox activity and related file-access or network records to determine whether data was uploaded.
Acquire and analyze installer-70930.exe, including its origin, hash, signature, and execution history.
Investigate the omar.haddad and maria.lopez authentication events and confirm whether the account use was authorized.
